ConnectionStrings.//: Point this at the same SQLite file the API writes. Relative paths resolve to the worker's working dir.

Resend.//: ApiKey falls back to the RESEND_API_KEY env var when omitted. Worker fails fast at startup if neither is set.

Delivery.//: TickInterval is the polling cadence; DigestDayOfWeek is 0=Sunday..6=Saturday (5=Friday).
